tasks.title: Workspace Inspector
tasks.prompt: Write a portable shell script that reports the current user, shell, date, and working directory. Include clear labels, handle an unset SHELL variable, and explain which commands supply each value.

tasks.title: File Permission Checker
tasks.prompt: Create an interactive Bash script that reads a path and reports whether it exists, is a regular file or directory, and is readable, writable, and executable. Quote variable expansions and handle a missing path.

tasks.title: Pipeline Reporter
tasks.prompt: Build a shell pipeline that reads a text file, selects a chosen field, filters matching rows, sorts them, and reports unique values with counts. Include a small sample input and expected output.

tasks.title: Scheduling Comparison
tasks.prompt: Implement FCFS and non-preemptive SJF for a small list of processes with arrival and burst times. Show execution order, completion time, waiting time, turnaround time, and average values; state how ties are handled.

tasks.title: Round Robin Trace
tasks.prompt: Implement Round Robin scheduling with a configurable time quantum. Print each dispatch interval and each process's completion, waiting, and turnaround time. Demonstrate one worked example.

tasks.title: Process-System-Call Map
tasks.prompt: Explain the parent/child relationship for fork(), how exec() changes the child process image, why wait() is used, and how exit() completes a process. Include a short C-like pseudocode sequence and expected process-tree diagram description.

tasks.title: Partition Allocator
tasks.prompt: Simulate First Fit, Best Fit, and Worst Fit for a list of free memory blocks and process requests. Show each allocation, remaining block sizes, and any request that cannot fit.

tasks.title: Page-Fault Comparator
tasks.prompt: Implement FIFO, LRU, and Optimal page replacement for a reference string and frame count. Print the frame contents after each reference, mark hits and faults, and compare total page faults.

tasks.title: Memory Concept Brief
tasks.prompt: Write a concise comparison of paging, segmentation, and virtual memory. Explain logical versus physical addresses, page/frame mapping, demand paging, and why excessive page faults can lead to thrashing.

tasks.title: Safe-State Checker
tasks.prompt: Implement a Banker's-algorithm safety check using Allocation, Maximum, and Available matrices. Print Need, the safe sequence if one exists, and explain why an unsafe state is not necessarily already deadlocked.

tasks.title: Bounded Buffer Plan
tasks.prompt: Design a producer-consumer solution for a bounded buffer using semaphores or clear pseudocode. Identify the mutex, empty-slot, and full-slot conditions and explain how the solution prevents overflow, underflow, and race conditions.

tasks.title: Deadlock Case Analysis
tasks.prompt: Construct a small resource-allocation example and identify whether mutual exclusion, hold-and-wait, no-preemption, and circular-wait all hold. Suggest one prevention strategy and describe its trade-off.

tasks.title: Disk Scheduler
tasks.prompt: Implement FCFS, SSTF, SCAN, and C-SCAN disk scheduling for a request queue, initial head position, and cylinder range. Show service order and total head movement; state the direction and endpoint assumptions.

tasks.title: Least-Privilege Audit
tasks.prompt: Write a safe Bash audit script that lists file type, owner, mode, and size for files in a chosen test directory, then checks whether a named file is readable, writable, or executable. Do not change permissions outside the test directory.

tasks.title: Archive-and-Verify
tasks.prompt: Write a shell script that accepts a directory argument, creates a timestamped tar.gz archive, verifies that the archive can be listed, and reports errors without deleting source files.
